response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) AS avg_of_avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(cnt) AS avg_track_count FROM (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bpm, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) t;

assumptions.assumption: Track count per media type is the number of tracks passing the Bytes filter (COUNT(*)); since Bytes > threshold excludes NULLs, this equals the count of tracks with non-missing Bytes.
Bytes is cast to REAL so the division is not integer division (unrounded result); Milliseconds is NOT NULL and assumed nonzero.
